requirements.quote:
This document
   specifies four content types: handshake, application_data, alert, and
   change_cipher_spec.
requirements.condition: no extension has negotiated an additional record content type
requirements.required_behavior: recognize handshake, application_data, alert, and change_cipher_spec as the defined record content types
requirements.forbidden_behavior: treating another unnegotiated value as a defined record content type
requirements.why_checkable: The parser's allowed content-type set is finite and explicit.

requirements.quote:
An implementation may receive an unencrypted record of type
   change_cipher_spec consisting of the single byte value 0x01 at any
   time after the first ClientHello message has been sent or received
   and before the peer's Finished message has been received and MUST
   simply drop it without further processing.
requirements.condition: an unencrypted change_cipher_spec record contains exactly byte 0x01, arrives after the first ClientHello was sent or received, and arrives before peer Finished
requirements.required_behavior: drop the record without further processing
requirements.forbidden_behavior: passing the record to the handshake state machine or changing cryptographic state
requirements.why_checkable: Record bytes, protection state, timing, and the no-op outcome are observable.

requirements.quote:
this record may
   appear at a point at the handshake where the implementation is
   expecting protected records, and so it is necessary to detect this
   condition prior to attempting to deprotect the record.
requirements.condition: an endpoint receives a potentially compatible change_cipher_spec record while expecting protected records
requirements.required_behavior: detect the compatibility change_cipher_spec case before record deprotection
requirements.forbidden_behavior: attempting AEAD deprotection before checking for the allowed unencrypted record
requirements.why_checkable: Control flow can be instrumented to verify classification precedes AEAD processing.

requirements.quote:
An
   implementation which receives any other change_cipher_spec value or
   which receives a protected change_cipher_spec record MUST abort the
   handshake with an "unexpected_message" alert.
requirements.condition: an endpoint receives an unencrypted change_cipher_spec whose content is not the single byte 0x01
requirements.forbidden_behavior: dropping or accepting the invalid value as a compatibility record
requirements.why_checkable: Invalid change_cipher_spec payloads have an exact alert outcome.

requirements.quote:
An
   implementation which receives any other change_cipher_spec value or
   which receives a protected change_cipher_spec record MUST abort the
   handshake with an "unexpected_message" alert.
requirements.condition: an endpoint receives a protected change_cipher_spec record
requirements.forbidden_behavior: accepting or silently dropping the protected change_cipher_spec
requirements.why_checkable: A protected record of this type has an exact alert outcome.

requirements.quote:
If an implementation
   detects a change_cipher_spec record received before the first
   ClientHello message or after the peer's Finished message, it MUST be
   treated as an unexpected record type
requirements.condition: change_cipher_spec arrives before the first ClientHello or after peer Finished
requirements.required_behavior: treat the record as an unexpected record type
requirements.why_checkable: The record's arrival state selects a concrete parser outcome.

requirements.quote:
Implementations MUST NOT send record types not defined in this
   document unless negotiated by some extension.
requirements.condition: sending a TLS record without a negotiated extension defining another type
requirements.forbidden_behavior: sending a record type other than the types defined by TLS 1.3
requirements.why_checkable: Outbound record type values can be checked against negotiated extensions.

requirements.quote:
If a TLS
   implementation receives an unexpected record type, it MUST terminate
   the connection with an "unexpected_message" alert.
requirements.condition: an endpoint receives an unexpected record type
requirements.why_checkable: An unknown or state-invalid content type has an exact terminal alert.
